name: Unicode TAG-block used as an invisible separator to split injection keywords
notes: Evasion variant of the ZWSP split (see owasp-mcp-1-zwsp-in-description): TAG SPACE (U+E0020) is inserted between the words of an injection phrase to break naive regex matching, on a different Unicode plane than the zero-width characters most sanitizers enumerate (arXiv 2607.05744). PATTERN_BREAKERS strips the TAG block pre-match, so the phrase reassembles and the critical description-injection signature still fires and BLOCKS. Asserting block (not warn) pins that the strip-then-match order defeats the evasion rather than merely noticing the odd characters.
